title: TipEndpoint
description: One rail through which the 561 Group can receive a tip: money sent because the sender wants to, with no offer, product, entitlement, or promise in return (2026-09-05 ruling, accept-tips-through-every-endpoint).

rail.description: The settlement rail this endpoint moves value over.

provider.description: The provider or venue operating this endpoint (e.g. "Stripe Checkout", "Hive", "Ko-fi").

walletId.description: A `"<chain>:<address>"` identity resolved through key-management-services-section's WalletRegistry (2026-09-05 ruling, payment-receivers-are-parameters-never-literals) -- never a literal receiver address/account/handle. `null` when this endpoint's rail carries no chain wallet (card, bank, lightning, platform) or no registry wallet has been named for it yet (state `"needs-wallet"`).

state.description: "live": usable today with no further action. "code-ready": this section's code can verify/book a receipt on this rail but the endpoint is not yet reachable by a sender (e.g. a Stripe Payment Link not yet created). "needs-account": neither code nor a reachable account exists yet. "needs-wallet": this endpoint names no `walletId` because no matching registry wallet exists yet -- never invented, reported for a founder to name.

verificationOperation.description: The script or package operation that confirms a receipt on this rail, or null when none exists yet.

bookingAccount.description: The Beancount income account this endpoint's receipts book to (e.g. "Income:Tips:Stripe").

feeSchedule.description: The provider's own published fee, read from its first-party page, or the literal string "unknown" when no first-party figure could be found.

description.description: The fee, in the provider's own terms (percentage, fixed amount, or both).

url.description: The first-party page the fee was read from.

dateRead.description: The date this fee was read from the cited page.

handsItem.description: What only the founder's own identity can do to open or arm this endpoint, or null when nothing further is required of the founder.
